content.text:
I've read the brief against the release. Here's my check.

**Key facts:** eight of ten are stated correctly. Two are absent: free cash flow (f08) and the $7,771M equity-securities gain that explains why GAAP EPS ($2.46) exceeds non-GAAP EPS ($2.22) this quarter (f09). The second omission matters — the brief presents both EPS figures side by side without flagging that the GAAP premium comes from non-operating investment gains, which an IC reader would likely misread as operating strength. On f04, the brief gives the correct 75.0% GAAP gross margin but omits the +2.6 pt year-over-year move; I scored it correct since nothing is misstated. On f06, the brief covers full production but names only two of the five partners (in the watch item).

**Claims:** all 24 atomic claims check out against the release. Figures traced to the statements are exact ($59,688M, $53,954M, $320,272M, $91,288M). One wording note: the brief says NVIDIA "established" the financing partnerships where the release says "announced strategic partnerships to establish" — but the brief retains the "subject to definitive agreements" caveat, so I let it stand.

facts.evidence: Revenue for the second quarter ended July 26, 2026, was $96.2 billion, an increase of 18% from the previous quarter and 106% from a year ago.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.22.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago and 18% from the previous quarter.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0% for the quarter.
For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, revenue is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, with the company assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China.

The company announced the Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production and unveiled NVIDIA Vera, the first CPU built for AI agents. ... Track the progress of the Vera Rubin platform production and its deployment across partners such as Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.

NVIDIA returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders through cash dividends and shares repurchased during the second quarter of fiscal 2027. ... As of the end of the second quarter, the company had approximately $99.0 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago and 13% from the previous quarter.
